checks.clause: Real F5, F6 and F7 on a selected timeline cell each apply once: F5 inserts one held frame, F6 promotes a held cell to a key with its content, F7 makes a blank key, each as exactly one revision and one history entry.

The right-click Insert a frame, Insert a keyframe, Insert a blank keyframe, Clear the keyframe and Delete the frames items, and the Extend exposure and Duplicate keyframe shortcuts, each apply once with the baseline timeline effect and one history entry.
One Cmd+Z undoes exactly the last frame edit and one Cmd+Shift+Z redoes it, read back from history depth and the cell runs.
After Save and reopening the saved file the edited timeline and total frames read back unchanged, the file bytes are untouched by opening, and the reopened history is fresh.

Inside an entered component F5, F6, F7, Extend exposure, Duplicate keyframe, Clear the keyframe and Delete the frames edit the component timeline with one revision and one history entry each, and the Scene timeline stays unchanged.

After Save and reopening, the entered component and the Scene timeline read back as saved, with the file untouched by opening.
Native timeline layer rows render as compact dark rows with single-line names and compact visibility, lock and shy controls that keep their accessible names.

checks.clause: Inside an entered component the Draw, Pen, Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Fill Brush and Bitmap Brush tools each draw one gesture on the component's layer with no unavailable notice: the cell gains content and, on a held frame, its own key, as exactly one revision and one history entry, with the Scene timeline unchanged.
One Cmd+Z inside the component undoes exactly the last drawing gesture and one Cmd+Shift+Z brings it back, read back from history depth and the cell runs, with the Scene timeline unchanged.
After leaving the component, the instance in the Scene shows the component's new drawing at its frame while the rest of the artboard is unchanged, judged from the helper's owned-window capture.
An exported PNG of a frame that shows a bitmap brush stroke painted inside the component contains that stroke's ink.

Break apart the component turns the instance layer into a drawing layer holding the component's frames and keys as one revision and one history entry, and one Cmd+Z and one Cmd+Shift+Z restore and redo it.
In Motion mode on a plain layer with no Motion animation, Draw, Pen and a shape each put their stroke on the playhead frame as one revision and one history entry, with the other layers unchanged.
After Save and reopening the saved file, the entered component's drawings and the Scene read back as saved, with the file bytes untouched by opening and a fresh history.

checks.clause: File > Open of a baseline project (version 13) opens it as a new document that is named after the old file, announced with the baseline Opened text plus the native new-project wording, with the scene frames, the component frames and the layer names the file declares and a fresh history.

A baseline project that uses expression globals or track roles is refused with a message naming the exact field path, and the document that was open stays exactly as it was.
